ranked for beginner to intermediate lifters:
small jumps, a setup you can repeat, safe to train alone.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#5 dumbbell front raise
light weights, so each dumbbell jump is a huge step.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#4 barbell overhead press
small plate jumps, but setup and stance drift between sessions.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#3 dumbbell lateral raise
a 2 kg jump is a big % for small muscles. add reps first.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#2 cable lateral raise
small pin jumps. stacks vary between gyms, so use the same one.

bonus tip: write the target down before the set, not after.

#1 machine shoulder press
fixed path, same seat, small jumps. the easiest to repeat and beat.
